topics.title: System Design Basics for Feature Teams
topics.overview: A practical introduction to system design decisions for small feature teams.
topics.background: The team is touching more services and needs a shared language for tradeoffs.
topics.whyItMatters: Better design conversations reduce rework and make implementation plans clearer.

topics.title: Risk-Based Testing Before Release
topics.overview: How QA, engineers, and BA can identify the riskiest flows before a release.
topics.background: Recent work needs faster confidence without expanding the full regression scope.
topics.whyItMatters: The team can spend testing time where defects would hurt users most.

topics.title: Frontend Performance Checks Without Heavy Tooling
topics.overview: A lightweight checklist for measuring and improving perceived UI speed.
topics.background: The demo product has simple pages, but performance habits should start early.
topics.whyItMatters: Small frontend decisions compound into user-visible latency and instability.

topics.title: Writing Acceptance Criteria That Engineers Can Build From
topics.overview: How to turn product intent into examples, edge cases, and testable outcomes.
topics.background: The team often needs clarification during implementation and test planning.
topics.whyItMatters: Sharper acceptance criteria reduce handoff friction across BA, dev, and QA.

topics.title: Debugging Playbooks for Common Production Issues
topics.overview: Create repeatable incident debugging steps for API, database, and UI issues.
topics.background: Shared playbooks help less experienced members contribute during incidents.
topics.whyItMatters: The team can reduce mean time to understand and recover from failures.

topics.title: Practical API Contract Review
topics.overview: A review checklist for API shape, error handling, versioning, and frontend needs.
topics.background: Frontend and backend alignment is a recurring source of implementation delays.
topics.whyItMatters: Early contract review prevents avoidable integration bugs.
